activeQuestion.prompt: What does the woman suggest may be the cause?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 女方認為可能的原因是什麼？

options.text: The server is working, but his account can open files without adding them.
options.zh: 伺服器正常，但他的帳號可查看檔案、不能新增檔案。
options.whyZh: 他開得了資料夾卻不能上傳，且伺服器運作中，符合只有讀取權限。

options.text: His account can add files, but the server outage prevents it for now.
options.zh: 他的帳號可以新增檔案，但伺服器停機暫時擋住上傳。
options.whyZh: 女方明說伺服器正常，沒有說帳號已具備寫入權限。

options.text: His account cannot view the folder, but it can submit the report.
options.zh: 他的帳號不能查看資料夾，但可以提交報告。
options.whyZh: 實際症狀相反：可以開啟資料夾，卻不能上傳。

options.text: The server is online, but the folder already contains the approved report.
options.zh: 伺服器正常，但資料夾裡已經有核准過的那份報告。
options.whyZh: 對話只提到經理請他加入報告，沒有說報告已存在。

group.title: Checking an access permission
group.passage:
Man: I can open the project folder, but I cannot upload the validation report. Is the server down?
Woman: The server is running. Your account may have read-only access. Have you just joined this project?
Man: Yes, this week. My manager asked me to add the report before the review meeting.
Woman: Please send me two things: the folder name and a copy of your manager's approval. I can request write access from the administrator.
group.passageZh:
男：我能開啟專案資料夾，但無法上傳驗證報告。伺服器當機了嗎？
女：伺服器正在運作。你的帳號可能只有唯讀權限。你剛加入這個專案嗎？
男：是，這個星期。主管要我在審查會議前加入報告。
女：請寄給我兩樣東西：資料夾名稱和一份主管的核准紀錄。我可以向管理員申請寫入權限。
